static_traits.name: Li Ruoqing
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never had similar psychological problems before; never received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude; clear expression; able to identify and describe one's own negative thinking patterns; fairly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: After a surfing wipeout, I have been plagued by negative thoughts and doubts, feeling not competent enough, and fearing being unable to conquer bigger waves.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear and Self-doubt have started affecting my daily life and overall well-being; hoping to gain support and guidance to manage these emotions and thoughts.
growth_experiences: A wipeout happened in a surfing accident a few months ago; since then stress and Anxiety related to surfing ability have risen significantly; Near the ocean or when thinking of surfing, catastrophic and 'worst-case' worries often appear; tried positive self-affirmation and mental imagery exercises, but they have not yet effectively relieved Fear and Self-doubt.

special_situations.event: Experiencing a fall while surfing or recalling the accident
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I wipe out once, it means I am not suited for bigger waves, and I will never learn in the future.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using positive affirmation and mental imagery exercises to counter Fear and Self-doubt.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never learn bigger waves.

special_situations.event: Approaching the ocean or thinking of bigger waves before surfing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot fully conquer bigger waves, it equals failure, meaning I am not competent enough.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to enhance the sense of control through self-encouragement and success visualization.

special_situations.event: School policy causes frequent announcements during class that interrupt lessons
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the class is interrupted, I cannot teach effectively, meaning I am not a good teacher.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reporting to the school and trying to change teaching methods to deal with interruptions.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: There is no point continuing to teach; I am not a good teacher.

special_situations.event: Thinking these classroom interruptions will keep happening
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If interruptions continue, my career will be affected, and I will be unable to teach effectively long-term.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to use reframing and positive statements to relieve worry.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen as competent and able to handle challenges (whether in surfing or teaching)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure, being proven not competent enough, thereby damaging self-worth and career prospects
defense_goal: Avoiding facing the sense of failure by maintaining rational explanations and self-persuasion
Reducing frustration and Anxiety by giving up or lowering investment

object_relations.object_representation: A dangerous and uncontrollable ocean/bigger waves
An institution / environment frequently interrupting and hard to control

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When class is frequently interrupted by broadcasts and the teaching rhythm is disrupted
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing outside interruptions mean one cannot handle teaching, and continued effort is also meaningless
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a helpless and negative tone, emphasizing 'continuing is also meaningless', reducing exploration of solutions, tending to end the topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When near the ocean, thinking of bigger waves, or recalling the experience of falling while surfing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing one failure as a permanent ability deficit, concluding one will never learn
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using absolutist words (such as 'forever' 'definitely'), tense tone, Anxious, negating any middle possibilities and positive evidence.

manifestations: Handling most situations alone, not sharing Fear and Self-doubt with others
Lacking use of the Social support system
outcomes: Helplessness in Work and life experiences

manifestations: Believing 'continuing teaching is meaningless' when the class is interrupted
Treats one failure as a permanent defeat; feels effort is futile
outcomes: Tendency to avoid or reduce investment

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Not sharing Fear and Self-doubt with others, bearing it alone
Under stress, pushes back inward the need that should seek support outward

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Using Self-denial statements like 'I am not a good teacher'
Overly caring about uncontrollable interruptions and attributing them to one's own shortcomings

exception_events.target_problem: When the class is frequently interrupted by school broadcasts, the client usually feels persistent frustration and believes continuing teaching is meaningless, further worrying about career damage.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During an uninterrupted class period, Students still Learned and actively participated, and she received positive feedback from Students and parents, experiencing her teaching effectiveness.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different situation — no broadcast interruptions during that period; different support — positive feedback from Students and parents as evidence, helping her see her own impact.

positive_force: Self-driven and willing to seek counseling support
Able to identify and practice restructuring negative thinking (willing to try alternative perspectives and visualization exercises)
Having received positive feedback from Students and parents, with evidence of effective teaching
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization are significant
Tending to bear it alone, not yet effectively using Social support
Strong need for control over uncontrollable environments, easily personalizing outside interference

antecedent: Thinking about surfing or bigger waves
Recalling the surfing fall accident months ago
target_behavior.core_reason: The surfing accident Reinforced negative core beliefs about one's abilities, forming cognitive biases of catastrophizing and overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential danger; gains short-term safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Hard to enjoy surfing; lifestyle and mental health affected

target_behavior.behavior: Give-up self-talk and helpless feelings when the class is interrupted
antecedent: The school frequently broadcasts during class, interrupting lessons
Anticipating continued interruptions in the future
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizing external interruptions and evaluating performance by black-or-white standards
target_behavior.function: Reducing the current Sense of frustration through Rationalization, finding reasons to lower investment
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in job satisfaction, affected interactions with colleagues and family, attention and Sleep problems worsening
